summary: Join our training course on Operational Risk Management tailored for credit institutions. Equip yourself with essential strategies to manage risks successfully.
lede: Operational risk training for credit-institution professionals covers how to identify, assess and control risks arising from people, processes, systems and external events. Participants practise mapping risks, assessing exposure, developing key risk indicators and designing internal controls and mitigation plans. The syllabus also covers incident reporting, business continuity and integrating operational risk with broader enterprise risk management.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals in credit institutions who are responsible for managing or overseeing risk-related activities. It is especially relevant for those who need to address the increasing demands of regulatory compliance and risk mitigation.
modules: Measuring and Assessing Operational Risk Exposure
Developing and Monitoring Key Risk Indicators (KRIs)
Designing Internal Controls and Risk Mitigation Strategies
Risk Event Management and Incident Reporting
Integrating Operational Risk with Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)
Crisis Management and Business Continuity Planning
prerequisites: This course requires participants to have a basic understanding of risk management principles and experience in a financial services environment. Familiarity with Basel III and ISO 31000 is beneficial but not mandatory.
